scripts.desktop: npm run build && npx cap copy @capacitor-community/electron && npx cap open @capacitor-community/electron
scripts.electron:sync: npm run build && npx cap copy @capacitor-community/electron && node -e "require('fs').copyFileSync('credentials.json', 'electron/credentials.json')"
scripts.electron:pack: npm run electron:sync && npm --prefix electron run electron:pack
scripts.electron:build: npm run electron:sync && npm --prefix electron run electron:make
scripts.electron:portable: npm run electron:sync && npm --prefix electron run electron:portable
